verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents programmatic access through its own HTTP and native ClickHouse protocol interface, which any client or driver can use to run SQL (docs-5, docs-6). It also exposes an MCP surface with tools to list services, run SQL and read monitoring, plus CHKit typed commands an agent can use to deploy schema and pipelines (docs-7, docs-11). However, no documented public control-plane or REST management API is evidenced for creating and resizing clusters, managing branches, configuring alert rules or administering access. missing for 10: a documented public management/control-plane API (cluster lifecycle, scaling, branching, alerts, access) with API reference docs, and independent corroboration.
